description:
Welcome to your beautifully renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bath duplex where thoughtful design and quality craftsmanship truly shine. From the moment you step inside, you’ll notice the natural light pouring through the space, highlighting the warm, stained natural flooring and clean, modern finishes throughout. The bathroom features a stunning marbled shower that adds a touch of luxury. Every detail has been carefully considered, giving the home a polished, cohesive feel. This isn’t just another rental, you can genuinely feel the care and attention that went into making it special. A perfect blend of comfort, style, and charm, this duplex is ready to welcome you home.
